# The Hidden Laws of Money

> A book by Eric Coste: ten unspoken rules that quietly decide who builds wealth and who stays stuck, framed as the "operating system" wealth-building households already run on. Not financial, legal, or investment advice.

## Book details
- Title: The Hidden Laws of Money: The Rules That Quietly Decide Who Wins and Who Stays Broke
- Author: Eric Coste
- Length: 96 pages
- ISBN-13: 979-8195172138
- Published: May 1, 2026
- Includes a 36-page companion action workbook (PDF and DOCX)

## Where to get it
- Digital edition (PDF, EPUB, DOCX workbook) — $26: https://payhip.com/b/DzR2a
- Kindle ($8.99) and paperback ($26), with a free "Look Inside" preview: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GZFDCBS2

## Sample lines from the book
- "These rules don't care how smart you are. They operate in the background, like gravity." (Introduction, p.1)
- "If the rules you've been following were designed by someone else, for someone else's benefit, what would you do differently if you finally learned your own?" (Introduction, p.3)
- "The most dangerous financial influence in your life is rarely a bad investment. It's a close relationship with a low financial ceiling." (Chapter 3, p.18)
- "High earners with low velocity are just broke people with better wardrobes and more sophisticated stress." (Chapter 4, p.26)
- "The game was always being played. Now you know the rules. The rest is yours to write." (Final Word, p.89)
